features.name: char_freq_sum
features.description: Sum of special character frequencies, indicating heavy punctuation/symbol use common in promotional content.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree can split on overall symbolic noise level in a single threshold.
features.formula: char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5

features.name: active_word_token_count
features.description: Count of word_freq columns that are strictly positive, a proxy for vocabulary breadth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Trees can split on how many distinct tracked tokens appear; high counts often co-occur with marketing emails.

features.name: max_word_freq
features.description: Maximum frequency across all word features; highlights when any single token dominates the message.
features.expected_model_benefit: Trees can detect over-concentration on a single keyword via one split.

features.name: capital_run_length_avg_log
features.description: Log-transformed average capital run length, compressing the extreme right tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes a highly skewed predictor so tree splits land in more informative regions.

features.name: capital_run_length_total_log
features.description: Log-transformed total number of capital letters across the message.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compressed range improves split selection on heavy-tailed capital-letter totals.

features.name: capital_longest_to_avg_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the longest capital run to the average capital run, capturing burstiness of capitalization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Distinguishes messages with one shouting block from uniformly capitalized text.

features.name: high_capital_burst_flag
features.description: Boolean indicator for unusually long capital letter runs (longest run > 50).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean binary cue for shouting-style content that trees can pick up immediately.

features.name: char_to_word_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total special character frequency to total word frequency, capturing symbol-heavy phrasing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree can split on relative symbolic density independent of message length.

features.name: dollar_and_exclaim_interaction
features.description: Product of dollar-like and exclamation-like character frequencies (char_freq_4 * char_freq_5), capturing combined urgency-monetary cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree benefits from a precomputed multiplicative interaction between two strong symbolic indicators.

features.name: capital_bucket_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal bucket of total capital letter count: 0 (<=20), 1 (<=100), 2 (<=500), 3 (>500).
features.expected_model_benefit: Precomputed bins give the tree a coarse but interpretable feature for capitalization intensity.

features.name: promotional_language_intensity
features.description: Semantic judgment score combining heavy capitalization, high symbol density, and broad keyword usage into a single intensity proxy reflecting messages that read as promotional or unsolicited based on stylistic surface features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bundles correlated stylistic cues into one feature so the tree can split on overall promotional tone with shallow depth.
